_doc: Strategy graph Phase 3 tunables (api/lib/assistant/strategy-gaps.js, strategy-design.js, strategy-promote.js). Numbers, not logic.

theory._doc: jev-tuning/theories.js: a weak gate verdict → Opus theories → tested on historic + frozen synthetic gold.

unmatched._doc: unmatched.js: a live Unmatched turn. a pending candidate is reused only when the recheck model names it (never by word overlap); the timeouts are safety bounds on the LLM calls (any failure falls back to the researcher).

miss_fix._doc: jev-tuning/miss-fix.js: sample sizes of the replay (the experiment spend is theory.max_usd, through the improve ledger).
